The three DEC-1067 items are covered by four new S7 cases, committed as `102bacc4` on `w2/W2-32-tests` (not merged). All four are red on W2-32's head `2ea1a524`, and none of the new behaviour is green there yet. The rest of W2-32's suite passes there.

**Sandbox check:** (a) the write to `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/.sandbox-trial-DAEO-0pyc` was refused (read-only file system, no file created); (b) `git hash-object -w --stdin` (`1ae28402a109`) and `git update-index --refresh` both worked.

**ps check:** `ps -eo pid,args | grep -iE "[o]llama|[l]lama-server"` printed nothing. Stand-ins only; empty `HOME` with `PYTHONUSERBASE=/home/usain/.local`; the exclusion flags on every run (they left nothing out of W2-32's folder). No merge, no `git worktree prune`, no git config written; scratch commits used `-c` identity only.

- **task:** acceptance cases from S7's line and its DEC-1067 note: the 16-text reranker cap, no span sent twice in the converse direction, and the embedder's limit named.
- **status:** DONE.
- **work_completed:** a new file `test_w2_32_s7_dec1067.py` with 3 functions (4 cases):
  - **The cap,** `test_no_reranker_request_carries_more_than_16_texts_and_the_order_is_the_unbatched_one` (via the fusion and via `retrieve`):
    - a rerank pool above 16 goes out in requests of at most 16 texts;
    - the final order equals the order the same scores give unbatched;
    - the stand-in reranker keeps each request and scores each text by a hash, so no two texts tie.
  - **The converse,** `test_a_parent_expanded_later_leaves_out_the_children_sent_alone_earlier_and_names_them`:
    - one item a batch, a budget of 1,000 tokens;
    - call 1 sends two chunks of a 44-line section alone, and a later call expands the section;
    - no later item may hold a span sent earlier, and an expansion must name what it left out.
  - **Direction (a)** (a span inside a parent expanded earlier is left out and named) stays as the existing `test_w2_32_s7_whole_chunk.py::test_across_continuations_no_span_is_sent_twice`.
  - **The embedder's limit,** `test_a_chunk_above_the_embedders_limit_is_embedded_from_its_first_part_and_named`:
    - a one-line chunk of over 40,000 characters is embedded from its first part, at most 16,384 characters (4,096 tokens at four characters each), and the rebuild succeeds;
    - the rebuild's report names the chunk's path, and not every file's.
  - The driver gains the per-request recording reranker.
  - **README:** S7's row lists the three new functions in full node ids, with a round note and updated counts (105 cases, 50 functions, 9 files). I also took stray backticks out of the S3 row, which had made three non-test items appear in the map.
- **files_changed:** `tests/acceptance/W2-32/test_w2_32_s7_dec1067.py` (new), `w2_32_driver.py`, `README.md`. Commit `102bacc4`, with Task, `Implements: DEC-1067`, Role and Co-Authored-By.
- **evidence (on `2ea1a524`, scratch tree):**

  | Case | Today | Why |
  |---|---|---|
  | cap, the fusion | red | one request of 30 texts |
  | cap, `retrieve` | red | one request of 20 texts |
  | converse | red | call 2 sends lines 1–46, which holds 16–31 already sent alone in call 1 |
  | embedder limit | red | 32,768 characters sent, and the chunk isn't named |

  Each red stops at its first check, so I checked the later ones with that first check removed or raised, in a scratch copy only:
  - **Cap case:** the order check alone passes, so batching just has to keep it.
  - **Embedder case:** with the limit raised, the first-part check passes and it fails only on the naming.
- **tests:** W2-32's whole suite on `2ea1a524`: 98 passed, 4 failed (the new cases), 3 skipped.
  - S5's order case skips because this build refuses a limit above its cap.
  - The two record cases skip only because an empty `HOME` hides `~/gov-os-runs`; with `W2_32_RUNS=/home/usain/gov-os-runs/D4B` set, all 14 record cases pass.
- **discoveries:** Today's code already cuts embedder input, but at 32,768 characters, above the shared embedder's ~15,000-character context, and without naming the chunk.
- **risks:**
  - The 16,384-character bound assumes the engineer's named limit is at most 4,096 tokens at roughly four characters each. If they choose another unit, this bound still holds as a ceiling.
  - The naming check looks for the path anywhere in the rebuild's result; it doesn't check the count.
- **lessons:** Under an empty `HOME`, a case that reads `~/...` skips silently. Set its path variable explicitly.
- **proposed_decisions:** None.
- **unresolved:** S8 (routing by question type) and S6 in later rounds; the real-model cases still need the outside run.
- **recommended_next_action:**
  1. Merge `102bacc4` into `w2/W2-32`; after the engineer's DEC-1067 work, run `gov accept W2-32` outside the sandbox.
  2. When you run the suite with an empty `HOME`, set `W2_32_RUNS=/home/usain/gov-os-runs/D4B`.
